title: Crop Change & Farmland Dynamics
subtitle: Inter-annual parcel transitions (AY 2023-24 vs AY 2025-26)
key_finding: Evaluated 3,011.2 ha of 3,011.2 ha cropland (confidence ≥ 0.60): 52.9% of paddy and 1.3% of banana parcels remained stable across 2023–2026, with 100.5 ha (3.3%) identified as candidate paddy-to-banana diversification.
coverage_note: Evaluated 3,011.2 ha of 3,011.2 ha (both years with probability ≥ 0.6)

Stable Paddy.desc: Paddy in both AY 23-24 and AY 25-26

Candidate Paddy \u2192 Banana.desc: Potential diversification from annual paddy to perennial banana

Banana \u2192 Paddy.desc: Banana replanting cycle / rotation back to paddy

Cropland \u2192 Fallow/Loss.desc: Cultivated land converted to fallow or non-agricultural use

method: Cross-tabulation of independent Random Forest predictions for AY 2023-24 and AY 2025-26. Only pixels with posterior class probability ≥ 0.6 in both agricultural years are evaluated to prevent artifact-induced spurious transitions.
limitations: AY 2023-24 relies on single-satellite Sentinel-1 (S1A); banana may be under-detected in that year.
